claims.claim: Nikon z fc is a retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera featuring a 20.9-megapixel APS-C sensor.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Nikon camera body and attached lens, but the exact model (Z fc) and any sensor/megapixel details are not readable.

claims.claim: The item is a Nikon camera.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies Nikon brand from photo 0/1/2 (camera body and lens area visible).

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (e.g., different Nikon body) which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., Z fc marking) and the lens model/part number ring.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as an unidentified Nikon mirrorless/DSLR body with attached lens, with condition and specs unknown.

risks.risk: Lens condition issues (haze/fungus/oil on blades) or poor optical clarity not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element (if possible), plus a shot of the lens against bright light to show haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens optics potentially compromised (treat as not fully guaranteed), reducing value until clarity is confirmed.

risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or have faults (shutter, autofocus, metering, flash, buttons/ports).
risks.proof: A short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a subject, and a test photo being taken (with flash test if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested functionality (worst-case) until a working test is shown.

risks.proof: A photo of the sensor at high magnification (or a test image of a blank wall/sky at high f-stop showing dust spots).
risks.if_unproven: Price as sensor condition unknown and potentially dirty, discounting until a dust test is provided.

risks.risk: Battery health/charging and battery door/contacts may be faulty.
risks.proof: A clip showing the battery charging (or battery indicator during operation) and a photo of battery contacts/door fitment.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming battery health is unknown and may not hold charge well.

risks.risk: Memory card included may be low capacity or not working.
risks.proof: A clear shot showing the memory card label/capacity and a clip showing the camera reading it (playback of a taken photo).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming card is included but not guaranteed working/adequate.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness (charger, cables, strap, original box/manual) may be missing, lowering resale value.
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of all included accessories (charger model, cable types, strap, manuals/box if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as minimal accessories only (camera + lens + basic caps/battery/card shown), until full kit is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact camera model marking (confirm Z fc) and the serial number/label.
Clear photo of the lens model/part number (on the lens barrel) and mount compatibility.
Short video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock, and taking a test photo (plus playback).
Test image of a blank wall/sky at high f-stop to reveal sensor dust.
Photos of lens front and rear elements in bright light to check haze/fungus/oil.
Photo/video showing battery charging/indicator and confirming battery door/contacts are intact.
Photo showing memory card capacity/label and a clip confirming the camera reads it and plays back a shot.
Full accessories layout showing whether charger/cables/strap/manual/box are included.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon camera with an attached lens, but the exact model (e.g., Z fc) and working/condition details needed to price confidently are not readable or shown. Request proof of model identity and a basic working test before pricing.
